The '''Picutorion system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Kwymar sector/Legends|Kwymar sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Picutorion/Legends|Picutorion]].
